title: Users must be prevented from changing installation options.
check_content:
If the following registry value does not exist or is not configured as specified, this is a finding:

Registry Hive: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE
Registry Path: \SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer\

Value Name: EnableUserControl

Value Type: REG_DWORD
Value: 0
fixtext: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> Windows Components >> Windows Installer >> "Allow user control over installs" to "Disabled".
VulnDiscussion: Installation options for applications are typically controlled by administrators. This setting prevents users from changing installation options that may bypass security features.
